lines: All indexed attributes (FTS-indexed fields, vectors, filters, etc.) are billed at the same rate. By default attributes are at least indexed for filtering. Queries are billed as the sum of two components: the amount of data queried and the amount of data returned. Data queried is calculated as the actual size of the queried namespace or 1.28 GB, whichever is greater. We offer an 80% marginal discount on data queried between 32 GB and 128 GB, and a 96% …
Minimum charge: Every write is billed at least 10 KB, even if the actual size is smaller. A 1 KB write costs the same as a 10 KB write.
Batch write discount: The discount increases with batch size and reaches 50% at approximately 3.2 MB.

How it works: The discount is calculated once per batch based on the total batch size, then applied uniformly to all bytes in that batch. It is not tiered. If you send a batch that is 3.2 MB or larger, all bytes in that batch receive the 50% discount.
A 128 KB batch → ≈22% discount on all 128 KB → ~100 KB billable
A 512 KB batch → ≈34% discount on all 512 KB → ~337 KB billable
A 6 MB batch → 50% discount on all 6 MB → 3 MB billable
A 256 MB batch → 50% discount on all 256 MB → 128 MB billable
Note: Each API request is discounted independently. If you send multiple 256 MB requests, each gets the 50% discount separately.

Stacking discounts: These batch write discounts stack with non-indexed/non-filterable attribute discounts. For example, non-filterable attributes receive a 50% discount at the attribute level, and then the batch write discount is applied on top of that.
